snippet: Oscar Piastri has been handed a three-place grid penalty for the Italian Grand Prix after the stewards found him guilty of impeding Liam Lawson in Qualifying.

title: Gasly reacts to shock pole position for Italian GP
snippet: Pierre Gasly was suitably delighted after the Alpine driver caused an upset to claim pole position for the first time in his F1 career during Saturday’s Qualifying session at the Autodromo Nazionale Monza.

title: Lawson to start from the back at Monza after engine penalty

title: Scottish Premiership: Naderi strikes as Rangers earn third straight win
snippet: Dundee United score late in 1-1 draw with Falkirk Kilmarnock secure first point after Aberdeen stalemate Rangers striker Ryan Naderi accepted a gift to score the only goal against Motherwell at Ibrox.
